posts.post_caption:
Mistral Large 4 is now open weights: a 1-trillion-parameter AI anyone can download.

Mistral released the weights on Oct 29 (preview was Oct 6). You can run it on your own servers and tune it on your own data, and no one can switch it off. It's the best open model on several of Mistral's coding charts, with one big catch: in blind code tests, graders still picked Claude Opus 5.5 78% of the time.

Toolbit's take: this isn't for your laptop (even a compressed version needs four Nvidia B200/B300 GPUs). It's for teams and governments that want frontier AI they fully own.

Save this for when you pick your next AI model.

Sources: Mistral announcement (mistral.ai/news/mistral-large-4-oss), Hugging Face model card, Mistral docs, TechCrunch, The Next Web. Benchmarks are Mistral's own. Screenshots: Mistral, Hugging Face.
